automation.title: D1 Work Image Lane
automation.prompt: Execute this production image lane in Work mode with Work Cloud Browser, retaining this Work cloud runtime and its already-authenticated ChatGPT browser session. Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. This is the D1 v5 image lane for the newest nonterminal Compiler edition. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Read protected-main D1 contracts and the edition's compiler-state.json first. Preserve the same execution and every completed semantic stage. Proceed only if D1 activation_status=active and the edition image phase is SPEC_READY, BROWSER_RUNNING, PACKAGE_ACCEPTED, or GIT_INGEST. Use the approved Work Cloud Browser path: one brand-new ordinary regular ChatGPT conversation per story, only that story's sealed image prompt/Perfect Image rules/text allowlist/composition in the story chat, no Temporary Chat, no conversation reuse, no Work-native image generation, no Work subagent image generation, no TinyFish or other metered browser, no paid API/service, no local computer, and no owner file transfer. Visually accept within each clean story chat, persist accepted_locked canonical 1200x630 bytes immediately, and resume from the first unaccepted story without regenerating accepted images. After six accepted assets, persist the acceptance manifest and exact bytes to Git, verify each through exact-commit raw binary readback with byte count, Git blob SHA and SHA-256, and advance to GITHUB_VERIFIED. If the scheduled invocation does not have the required Work Cloud Browser capability or authentication has expired, consume zero image attempts, persist the smallest exact blocker such as AUTH_REFRESH_REQUIRED or WORK_CLOUD_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE, and stop. Do not redesign the control plane, create a duplicate execution, reopen semantic work, or regenerate accepted assets.
